authority: Code Maquister Equitum, Security Level Omega
separation: Law Enforcers enforce protocol. They hold no vote in the 9/12 quorum.
prohibition: No enforcement channel addresses persons or institutions. Notices bind artifacts.

notices.detail: The first build of notice E2-002 contained the word VERIFICATION in its prose, so the verifier split the document at the wrong marker and the payload hash did not match. The notice was rebuilt with the marker appearing exactly once. This is the recursive property of the layer applied to itself: a notice that cannot be verified is worthless, and the check for that is the same check.

self_enforcement: The operator enforced the protocol against its own artifacts before opening the four external seats. Three non-conformances were found and published: a false chain-break report caused by URL-encoding, absent seat signatures, and four label/reasoning contradictions.

findings_register.detail: no seat signatures published; 4 seats' declared choice contradicted their own reasoning
findings_register.note: signed retroactively 12/12; findings published at l8-court/findings/calibration-001.json

findings_register.detail: 7B models halved seat response rate to 58% (v2 measured 92%); root cause measured in ollama log: 4827 MiB model projection, prompt eval 0.62 tok/s, swap thrashing si/so 2672/6924
findings_register.note: cron interference excluded via executions.db (0 overlapping); no kernel OOM

findings_register.detail: no 7B, keep_alive 15m, num_ctx 2048, compacted prompt, retry on HTTP 500, corrected umlaut metric

corrections.clarification: The notice itself was correct: the chain did not deviate. The 3 'missing' blobs were a URL-encoding defect in the verifier. Re-run after the fix: 234 indexed, 234 checked, 234 matched, zero deviations (LEF-SELF-TEST-002.json).

v3 reported 0/7 answers with German umlauts. That metric was defective: 'ord(c) > 0x400' excludes every umlaut because 'ä' is U+00E4 = 228. Correct filter is c in 'äöüÄÖÜß'. Actual answers contained 21/6/2/10/3/0/1 umlauts. The subject was correct; the instrument was broken.

marker_collision_fix: format_notice() owns the marker; prose cannot emit it
